title: Two maps over a geometric point have equal pullbacks of connected sections
statement: Let S,U,E be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let Omega be an algebraically closed field and q:Spec(Omega)\to S a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let h:U\to Spec(Omega), assume U is nonempty and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme], and let w:E\to Spec(Omega), v_1,v_2:E\to U satisfy v_i;h=w. Let t:E\to S with w;q=t. For a sheaf of sets F on the small etale site of S [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets, def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and a global section b of (h;q)^{-1}F, apply the adjunction unit along v_i, restrict to the identity etale object by the canonical pullback lift [def-pc-fibre-product], apply the chosen unit-compatible comparison c_{h;q,v_i} [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], and transport v_i;(h;q)=t. The two resulting global sections of t^{-1}F agree. No connectedness or nonemptiness of E is required.

source.place: Tag 0A3H, final paragraph, both pullbacks have the same stalk value; Tag 03P5, description of sections of constant sheaves

proof.text: Use the surjective constant-section map on connected U to express b as the inverse comparison applied to the sheafified constant section of a stalk element e. Only existence is needed from the bijection.

For a map v:E to U apply the naturality equation of the geometric constant-section theorem to e. Restrict that equation along the terminal lift I[E] to the base change of I[U]. Naturality of the composition comparison and of the inverse constant comparison move the restriction to their components at I[E]. Naturality of toSheafify identifies the restricted constant section with the same constant value e at I[E].

The component of eqToHom acts on sections by Eq.mp, using the existing private section_eqToHom lemma imported from EtaleGlobalSectionSquare (proved there by equality induction). Transport the section using v;h=w and w;q=t. Composing equality transports identifies it with the inverse comparison at (E,w) of the constant value e. Both v_1 and v_2 therefore yield this same section. This argument includes empty and disconnected E.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSet_geometricSection_two_pullbacks
    {S U E : Scheme.{u}} (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (q : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (h : U ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)) [ConnectedSpace U]
    (w : E ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)) (v₁ v₂ : E ⟶ U)
    (hw₁ : v₁ ≫ h = w) (hw₂ : v₂ ≫ h = w)
    (t : E ⟶ S) (ht : w ≫ q = t)
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (b : ((L (h ≫ q)).obj F).obj.obj (op I[U])) :
    P[h ≫ q,v₁,t,(by rw [← Category.assoc, hw₁, ht]),F] b =
      P[h ≫ q,v₂,t,(by rw [← Category.assoc, hw₂, ht]),F] b
